text: No tree-cover loss of 0.5 hectares or more was detected on this asset after 2020. The evidence, based on satellite data from 2021 to 2025, shows no stand-replacing tree-cover loss events within the asset boundary. However, smaller changes (under 0.5 ha) or those at the edges may not be captured due to the 30-meter pixel resolution. The asset had 43.3 hectares of forest cover in 2020, but no significant loss was observed in the following years. This assessment does not confirm compliance with any regulations but indicates no major deforestation occurred post-2020.
